subject: Copywriting
title: Take Back Control
description: A micro-lesson that makes Take Back Control usable.

hook.text: The Brexit campaign's slogan was 'Take Back Control.' Three words reframed an economic debate as emotional.

buildup.text: Dominic Cummings tested dozens of phrases. 'Take Back Control' won focus groups by a wide margin.

discovery.text: The word 'back' implied something was stolen. 'Control' felt empowering. Together they triggered loss aversion.

twist.text: Remain's slogan was 'Stronger In.' It was rational but flat. Emotion beat logic, 52% to 48%.

climax.text: Political strategists worldwide studied the result. The right three words can override years of policy debate.

punchline.text: Three words beat economic arguments. Emotion wins votes.

quiz.question: Who chose 'Take Back Control' as the Brexit slogan?
